old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a precision metalworking process, likely performed by a CNC (Computer Numerical Control) machine. The primary focus is on a cylindrical metal workpiece being machined. A tool, possibly a drill or milling cutter, is seen rotating and moving along the surface of the workpiece, removing material to shape it. Metal shavings are visible as they are ejected from the workpiece, indicating the cutting action. The background is dark, which helps to highlight the metallic surfaces and the intricate details of the machining process. The lighting is focused on the workpiece and the tool, creating a dramatic effect that emphasizes the precision and complexity of the operation. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains steady throughout, maintaining a consistent angle that allows viewers to observe the detailed interaction between the tool and the workpiece.

caption: The video captures a close-up CNC machining scene against a dark, softly lit background veiled in persistent hazy mist. An angled black spindle head with a metallic tool holder and a slender end mill occupies the upper left, its tip pressed into the left side of a machined metal part. The workpiece is a polished cylindrical block whose top is sculpted into curved, swept turbine-like blades rising from a shiny base at the lower right. Through the early frames the cutter stays engaged, sliding laterally along the upper edge of the blades as the spindle shifts position. The bladed structure and base remain the same solid object, with no visible deformation or material removal within these frames. As the sequence continues the tool lifts and pulls away, opening a clear air gap between the cutter tip and the top of the blades. The misty haze and dark gradient persist with subtle brightness shifts, while the overall framing drifts slightly. The excerpt thus shows an ongoing traversal giving way to a retraction, with the pass's start and finish lying outside this clip.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
